LanguageData.MiliraXian_BackStoryChild_Mingyuan_BS1.d: Mingyuan was born into an elite Milira noble family and trained across combat, knowledge, etiquette, administration, and survival.
LanguageData.MiliraXian_BackStoryAdult_Mingyuan_BS1.d: Mingyuan survived an otherworld war by burning her material body to release life energy, returning calm in daily life but relentless in battle.
